patterns.note: Full-width sections with content consistently constrained to a central maximum-width container, creating a clean and organized presentation.
Prominent, large, sans-serif headings, often in all caps, are used for impact, contrasting with smaller, legible sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
A high-contrast palette of black and white is dominant, accented by a distinctive vibrant teal for calls to action and key highlights.
Sections reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight vertical slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing content discovery.
Immersive hero sections feature full-bleed video or high-quality photography with a dark overlay, ensuring legibility for overlaid white text and calls to action.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header system where both a top announcement bar and the main navigation remain fixed at the top of the viewport after initial scroll, providing persistent access to key information and navigation.
Create full-width hero sections using a video background with a semi-transparent dark overlay to ensure text contrast, positioning large, bold text and prominent call-to-action buttons centrally.

Utilize JavaScript (e.g., Intersection Observer API or a library like GSAP ScrollTrigger) to trigger CSS keyframe animations, applying a fade-in and subtle upward translation effect to content blocks as they become visible within the user's viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Bold, large sans-serif headings (up to ~4-5x body text) with smaller, often uppercase, supporting labels, paired with a clean, readable sans-serif for body copy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle; buttons and input fields have a slight border-radius (e.g., 4-8px), while most other elements maintain sharp corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, while product grids maintain a tighter, organized density.

standout: This site stands out by effectively leveraging high-quality, aspirational video and photography of its niche product (eFoils) to create an immersive and desirable brand experience. The consistent use of a vibrant teal accent color against a clean black and white palette, combined with bold typography, reinforces a sense of adventure and premium quality, making the product feel both innovative and luxurious.
